unknowns.issue: No full current official Korean in-game ability description was extracted. Primary old official announcements only verify individual names. Do not present existing strategy paraphrases as verbatim official item descriptions.

The public Korean update index retrieved here stops at 2022-07-06. The current official roster API has 2026 characters but no skills. Newer skill names above require a current Korean client screenshot or official KR video/article verification.
기록/재생 ordinary descriptive verbs need not all become 낭독; preserve the distinction between record creation and the actual skill. Existing 판결 was not primary-verified here.
침식도, 침식의 조각, 이스인 skill-table names are indirect. Avoid substituting arbitrary names for the different 기생, 전송, 공포 processes.
당까마귀, 스쳐 날기, 흉조, 사냥, 순찰 found only in Korean community skill table. Do not invent 급강하 or globally replace the actual skill name 사냥.
곤충 떼 and 벌침 candidates not confirmed by primary KR ability text. Biography references to 벌 무리 are background prose and not adequate skill-name evidence.
Current 그림자 구역/잔영/잠행 explanatory strings show no immediate internally contradictory noun. Specific canonical abilities not primary-verified.

섭혼/탕백 are internally consistent and indirectly supported; 척혼령 is the bell item, while 탕백 is the ability. Avoid replacing every 종/방울 with a skill name indiscriminately. Fix the two form names separately.
안식의 길 confirmed primary. No primary confirmation found for exact tree noun; do not introduce 안식송 from memory.
극성/자기장/전극/전하 refer to potentially different objects/states; no blanket normalization without primary descriptions.
Specific current skill names were not primary-verified. Preserve descriptive metal/vine/transaction wording rather than inventing official names.

2022 primary announcement calls the jumping resource 체력, while current site sometimes says 에너지. Confirm current KR client before changing the current resource label; do not reproduce apparent legacy typo 낙하 가격.
케이지 normalization is safe internal consistency, but current full Korean ability names are still indirect.

The treatment tip says screen-adjacent walls can be seen through. Community skill text describes obstacles no longer blocking ultraviolet light near 광막, which may affect attacks rather than merely reveal vision. Do not rewrite mechanics solely from terminology evidence; source this claim separately.
Article alternates 광선 치료 구역 and 조명 구역 and contains inconsistent timing values. No duration/numerical changes are justified by this research.
Primary 상처 스탯 is not proof that the physical 가시 noun is wrong. Preserve 가시 unless the exact in-game description is checked.
